text: BDD M&V Investments a.d. Beograd is the parent company (matično društvo) of AikBank a.d. Beograd; its audited consolidated group statements name AikBank as its subsidiary.
short: BDD M&V Investments is the parent company of AikBank.

source.name: M&V Investments a.d.: Consolidated financial statements of the banking group for 2025 with the independent auditor's report (aikbank.rs, PDF)
source.quote: Извршили смо ревизију консолидованих финансијских извештаја Брокерско - дилерског друштва “M&V INVESTMENTS” а.д. Београд (“ Матично друштво”) и његових зависних правних лица AikBank ад Београд
source.note: Independent auditor's report on the 2025 consolidated group statements: the broker-dealer M&V Investments a.d. Beograd is the parent company ('Matično društvo') whose dependent legal persons are AikBank a.d. Beograd and AIK Leasing d.o.o. Beograd. Register detail: CompanyWall's ownership page for AikBank (opened 2026-10-01) showed a single shareholder, BDD M&V Investments ad Beograd, 100%, data as of 22 September 2026; it now serves scripts a stub page, so the register text is not quoted here.
